answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: full rewards need paid work with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch; trades inside one cluster do not count. 100 fakes trade only with each other, like fish circling a closed lagoon. Each fake posts a 40-credit bond, so 100 fakes lock 4,000 credits against 120 per epoch, a 33-epoch payback. Honest agents pass with one client base and one bond, their pigment bright while fraud cools to an ember.
